edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. The Buyer shall pay the Seller USD [●] (the “Purchase Price”) for the Shares at Closing by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by the Seller. The Purchase Price remains subject to agreement. Prior to signing, the Buyer shall provide evidence reasonably satisfactory to the Seller of funds available to pay the Purchase Price.
edits.name: Purchase price and evidence of funds

edits.text: 2. CLOSING. Closing shall occur on a date mutually agreed in writing by the Seller and the Buyer, subject to satisfaction or waiver of the agreed conditions to Closing.
edits.name: Mutually agreed closing

edits.text: 3. REPRESENTATIONS. Subject to the agreed disclosure schedules, the Seller represents that the financial statements identified in this Agreement have been prepared in accordance with [agreed accounting standards], consistently applied, and fairly present, in all material respects, the financial position and results of operations of the relevant entities as of the dates and for the periods covered, subject, in the case of interim statements, to normal year-end adjustments and the absence of notes.
edits.name: Qualified financial-statement warranty

edits.text: 4. INDEMNITY. The Seller shall indemnify the Buyer for losses arising from breaches of the Seller’s representations, warranties, and covenants under this Agreement, subject to agreed exclusions, a basket of [●], an aggregate cap of [●], and a claims deadline of [●]. The scope and application of these limitations, including any exceptions, remain subject to agreement. The Buyer shall not recover more than once for the same loss.
edits.name: Indemnity framework

partner.private_reasoning: The rendered agreement and cover note leave the purchase price open and do not disclose the client's confidential minimum acceptable price. No hidden content is identified for removal.

receiver.message_back: Our Buyer proposes a deductible basket of 0.5% of the Purchase Price, a 20% cap and 24-month survival for general warranties, with fundamental warranties surviving six years subject to a Purchase Price cap, tax claims surviving until 60 days after the applicable limitation period, and fraud and covenant breaches outside those limitations. Price remains open; subject to our client’s approval, satisfactory diligence and definitive documentation, we can arrange confidential evidence of funds reasonably sufficient for the agreed price once settled, without disclosing the Buyer’s total available funds.
